Season 1'' |author=[[Jason Fry]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Grosset & Dunlap]] |release date=[[October 29]], [[2009]]{{Amazon|url=Official-Episode-Guide-Season-Clone/dp/0448452472|text=The Official Episode Guide: Season 1 (Star Wars: The Clone Wars)}} |type=Paperback |pages=192 |dimensions= |weight= |isbn=9780448452470 |series=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book that details [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series. It was written by [[Jason Fry]] and published by [[Grosset & Dunlap]] on [[October 29]], [[2009]]. {{Book-stub}} ==Publisher's summary== '':''This episode guide was written by Jason Fry, author of the New York Times bestselling Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide. Packed with details and exclusive behind-the-scenes information about the first season of The Clone Wars, this book is a must have for fans of all ages. It contains 192 pages of full-color illustrations, a perforated season one poster, and exclusive behind-the-scenes commentary by Dave Filoni (Supervising Director) and Henry Gilroy (Head Writer).''''
